info.name: Production House CRM API
info.description:
Spring Boot backend for the Production House CRM.

1. Set baseUrl (default http://localhost:5000/api).
2. Run Auth > Register, then Auth > Login. Login saves the token used by every other request.
3. Users & Access adds production-only or vendor-only logins (admin only). All logins share the admin's records.
4. Each module's Create saves the new record's id for Get/Update and the Cleanup folder.

Leave email empty to get a fresh address on each Register. For the password reset, run Forgot password, put the 6-digit code in the otp variable, then run Verify OTP and Reset password.

Errors are always {"message": "..."}, plus "errors": {field: message} for validation failures.
